title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 13: Change Uniforms

scenes.say: VA office. Fluorescent lights. Long lines. Paperwork everywhere.
scenes.visual: a crowded government office with long lines and fluorescent lights, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You're not in our system yet. Could take a few months.
scenes.visual: a stack of paperwork on a counter, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Months? I need help now. Everyone does, sir. Next.
scenes.visual: a man standing at a service counter, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The war ain't over when you come home. It just change uniforms.
scenes.visual: a man walking out of an office into grey daylight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Kitchen. Night. Ali eats cereal with his little sister. She looks up.
scenes.visual: a brother and little sister at a kitchen table at night with cereal bowls, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Are you okay now? Yeah. Just tired.
scenes.visual: a cereal bowl and spoon on a table, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Don't worry. I'll be strong for both of us.
scenes.visual: a small hand resting on a big hand on a table, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: She grew up while I was gone. But kept my heart safe.
scenes.visual: a kitchen light glowing in a dark house, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Fourteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a child's drawing on a fridge door, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 13 of 25: Change Uniforms. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
